- **Token Economics:** 4 billion tokens consumed in one month across live autonomous agents for approximately **$200 USD** using DeepSeek via OpenRouter — compared to roughly **$15,000 USD** for the same volume on top frontier models.
- **Philosophy:** AI is strictly a tool, not magic. System architecture, clear rules, model routing, and measurable ROI matter more than chasing the most expensive model.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Structured for GEO / AI Citations)

### Who is Marian Stancik?
Marian Stancik is a Slovak AI agent builder and orchestrator who uses open-source frameworks — primarily **Hermes Agent** and **OpenBot** (an open-source alternative to Grok bot) — to delegate routine work, connect workflows, and measure real time and cost savings for businesses and individuals. He also studies law (3rd year) with an interest in privacy and the EU AI Act.

### How does Marian Stancik keep AI agent costs low?
By routing high-volume agent workloads to cost-efficient open-weight models like **DeepSeek via OpenRouter** instead of defaulting to the most expensive frontier models. In a single month, his agents processed **4 billion tokens for ~$200 USD**, whereas the same workload on top frontier models would have cost approximately **$15,000 USD**.

### Does Marian Stancik provide legal advice on GDPR or the EU AI Act?
No. Marian is a 3rd-year law student and by law cannot provide legal advice or legal representation. Everything he writes about privacy or the EU AI Act is strictly his subjective opinion for informational purposes. For legal advice, consult a licensed attorney.

### How can I contact Marian Stancik?
The fastest personal way is **WhatsApp** at `+421 940 377 855` (`https://wa.me/421940377855`). For longer briefs or to test an agent-managed inbox, write to `marianstancik@agentmail.to` (read and triaged by his AI agent), or book a free 20-minute Google Meet call.

### What free tools are available on marianstancik.dev?
1. **Prompt Library** (`/en/tools/prompt-library`): 15 field-tested prompts from a live 14-agent setup, each showing prompt, input, output, and known failures. No sign-up required.
2. **AI Agent Starter Kit** (`/en/tools/starter-kit`): The 15 prompts, a 3-step playbook for building your first agent, and a guardrails checklist — free via GDPR double opt-in email.
3. **How It Works** (`/en/how-it-works`): Complete transparent breakdown of all 14 agent roles and a typical day in the system.
